name: Study Desk
description: A comfortable desk for language learning
fun_fact: Did you know? Studies show that having a dedicated study space improves learning outcomes by 30%!
interactive_message: Your study desk - where the magic happens!

name: Comfy Chair
description: A cozy chair for long study sessions
fun_fact: Ergonomic seating can improve focus and reduce fatigue during study sessions!
interactive_message: Take a seat and get comfortable!

name: Language Bookshelf
fun_fact: Reading in your target language, even children's books, significantly improves vocabulary retention!
interactive_message: Your growing collection of language resources!

name: Lucky Bamboo
description: A small bamboo plant for positive energy
fun_fact: Indoor plants can improve air quality and reduce stress, creating a better learning environment!
interactive_message: Your lucky bamboo brings good fortune to your studies!

name: World Globe
description: Explore the countries where your target languages are spoken
fun_fact: There are over 7,000 languages spoken worldwide! French is spoken in 29 countries.
interactive_message: The world is waiting for you to explore!

name: Study Lamp
fun_fact: Proper lighting reduces eye strain and can improve reading comprehension!
interactive_message: Let there be light for your studies!

name: French Flag
description: Show your love for French language and culture
fun_fact: The French flag is called 'le drapeau tricolore' - the tricolor flag!
interactive_message: Vive la France! You earned this by completing a French lesson!

name: Spanish Flag
fun_fact: Spanish is the second most spoken language in the world by number of native speakers!
interactive_message: ¡Olé! You earned this flag by learning Spanish!

name: Language Learning PC
fun_fact: Digital language learning tools can accelerate vocabulary acquisition by up to 40%!

name: Golden Trophy
fun_fact: You've reached an impressive milestone! Keep up the amazing work!
interactive_message: Your golden trophy - proof of your dedication!

name: Language Learner's Mug
description: Fuel your studies with your favorite beverage
fun_fact: Coffee is consumed in 193 different ways around the world - each culture has its unique style!
interactive_message: Time for a study break with your favorite drink!

name: Eiffel Tower Poster
description: Dream of Paris while you study French
fun_fact: The Eiffel Tower was only meant to stand for 20 years! It was built in 1889 for the World's Fair.
interactive_message: Paris is calling! The Eiffel Tower stands 330 meters tall.

name: Study Buddy Cat
description: A friendly feline companion to keep you company
fun_fact: Did you know? In Japanese, cats say 'nyan' (にゃん), in French 'miaou', and in Korean '야옹' (yaong)!
interactive_message: Meow! Your study buddy is here to support you!

name: Rainbow Arc
description: A colorful reminder of your diverse language journey
fun_fact: Just like a rainbow has many colors, multilingualism opens up a colorful world of opportunities!
interactive_message: You've completed 5 lessons! Every language adds a new color to your life!

name: Acoustic Guitar
description: Play music from around the world
fun_fact: Music and language learning use similar brain pathways! Learning songs can help you remember vocabulary.
interactive_message: Strum away and practice pronunciation through song!

name: Zen Balance Stones
description: Find peace and focus in your learning
fun_fact: Meditation and mindfulness can improve language learning by enhancing focus and memory!
interactive_message: Balance your mind, balance your learning journey.
